articles.title: Bill Gates Says Global AI Framework May Be Harder Than Cold War Nuclear Talks and Is Not a Hoax
articles.description: Bill Gates said reaching a global agreement on artificial intelligence could be harder than Cold War nuclear arms talks, urging mandatory safeguards and rejecting claims that catastrophic AI risks are a hoax.
articles.content: WASHINGTON — Bill Gates said Sunday that getting countries to agree on a global framework for artificial intelligence could be harder than Cold War talks that limited nuclear weapons, and he rejected… [+4957 chars]
